candidate_name: Porto do Açu onshore LNG regasification & storage terminal (GNA + NTS)
sponsor_or_proposer: Gás Natural Açu (GNA) [JV of Prumo Logística, BP, Siemens Energy] + Nova Transportadora do Sudeste (NTS)
current_state: Feasibility-study agreement only. On 2025-07-28 (during the GNA II thermal plant inauguration, Lula present), GNA signed a non-binding commitment ('assinou um compromisso') with NTS to STUDY the installation of a NEW onshore LNG regasification + storage terminal at Porto do Açu (São João da Barra, RJ), to be connected to the national grid via the proposed GASINF pipeline (~105 km to NTS's Cabiúnas/Macaé terminal, up to 16 MMcm/d). Potential investment up to R$6 billion. EPE's broader gas-integration narrative also references an onshore Açu terminal in partnership with NTS. Technical+regulatory viability studies said to begin 'immediately'; no capacity, FEED, EIA filing, or FID disclosed.
missing_threshold_elements: Concrete step: only a study/MOU to evaluate the POTENTIAL/feasibility of the terminal — not a committed development step (no FEED award, no site/EIA permit filing, no FID, no announced capacity). Sponsor (GNA+NTS) and location (Porto do Açu) are both met; the project is held below the 'sufficient information to add' bar on the concrete-step element only.
watch_for: FEED contract award; EIA/IBAMA or ANP authorization filing for an ONSHORE Açu terminal; a named capacity (MMcm/d or MTPA); GASINF pipeline licensing progress; any FID. If a concrete step lands, stage as a NEW terminal (distinct from existing Porto do Açu FSRU, T100000130688 — onshore vs floating BW Magna) with an AssociatedTerminals link to the FSRU. Re-check ~2026-Q4.
notes: VERIFIED (url_verifier PASS, tokens GNA/NTS/Açu). Corroborated by Reuters (via br.investing.com), Diário do Rio, ABEGÁS, Cenário Energia, and the EIA Today-in-Energy roundup. Distinct facility from GEM's existing Porto do Açu FSRU (floating, operating, BW Magna): this is an ONSHORE regas+storage terminal proposal at the same port complex. Second corroborating verified URL: https://en.clickpetroleoegas.com.br/gna-anuncia-investimento-de-r-20-bilhoes-em-novos-projetos-no-porto-do-acu-ama01/ (PASS).
